why: The buttons that were already dead when check-dead-buttons.mjs landed, and who is fixing each.
Twenty-two of them when this branch opened, all already tracked by an open issue with a branch
in flight. Blocking on those would have meant either editing four other people's files or not
landing the check at all, so they are recorded here instead: a new dead button fails from the
first commit, these fail the moment their branch lands and this entry is not deleted with it.
Seventeen went while this branch was open, as #55 deleted the address picker mock, #50 wired
the list controls, #57 built the contract-line actions and #58 built the scanner. The check
named every one of them as stale, by id — twice on this PR's own CI run — and would not go
green until they were deleted. That is the point of the file.
owner  the GitHub issue tracking the fix. Its branch is SL-<number>. It must be an OPEN issue:
#50 closed leaving two of its buttons behind, and pointing at a closed issue would have
made this file the only record of them. They were refiled as #66 instead.
note   what the button is supposed to do once it is wired. Written so the entry can be judged
without opening the issue, and so a stale entry is obvious when the check names it.
Entries are keyed on '<file> :: <name>', never on a line number — four other branches were
editing these files, and every id here survived that. The check prints the id to paste.
This file only ever shrinks. An entry that no longer matches a dead button fails the check by
name and has to be deleted — a baseline nobody is forced to shrink stops being a debt and
becomes a permission. Nothing may be added here that was not already dead on 2026-08-23.

entries.note: The create-the-first-record call to action, shown when a list is empty and has no prerequisite. Should be the Link the list header now uses. Survived the #50 merge, which wired the header but not this.
The header primary action, taken when the caller passes no primaryActionTo. Every caller should pass one so this dead branch stops existing. Also survived the #50 merge.
